description: This source file `group_get_vector.c` implements functions for managing and retrieving parameters in grouped or individual manner within a data model framework. It allows initialization, memory management, adding parameters or groups, converting to key-value representations, and fetching parameter values collectively or individually, utilizing callback mechanisms. The code is typical of a module that handles efficient bulk parameter retrieval in a TR-069-like or similar device management system.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Init(group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Initializes a group get vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Destroy(group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the group get vector, including all contained parameter entries and their associated strings.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Add(group_get_vector_t * ggv,char * path,int group_id)
methods.description: Adds a new parameter path entry with associated group ID to the group get vector, reallocating memory as needed.

methods.name: int GROUP_GET_VECTOR_FindParam(group_get_vector_t * ggv,char * path)
methods.description: Searches for a parameter path within the group get vector and returns its index or INVALID if not found.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_AddParams(group_get_vector_t * ggv,str_vector_t * params,int_vector_t * group_ids)
methods.description: Adds multiple parameter paths and their group IDs to the vector, transferring ownership of strings.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_ConvertToKeyValueVector(group_get_vector_t * ggv,kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Converts the internal group get vector into a key-value pair vector, transferring ownership of data, and frees the original vector.

methods.name: void GROUP_GET_VECTOR_GetValues(group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Retrieves values for all parameters in the vector, either individually or in grouped chunks via callbacks, and populates their value fields.

methods.name: void GetParameterGroup(int group_id,group_get_vector_t * ggv,int_vector_t * iv,int start_index,int chunk_size)
